designer_plugin_description: A design surface beside the conversation.
designer_blank_state: Create a project in the sidebar to open its viewport.
designer_viewport_scene: A rectangle with a hue of {hue} on a dark gray background.
designer_canvas_instructions: Press Enter or Space to select the rectangle. Press Escape to clear the selection.
designer_selection_rectangle: Rectangle selected. X {x}, Y {y}, width {width}, height {height}.
designer_geometry_invalid: Enter a number that keeps each edge between {min} and {max} and each dimension at least {size}.
designer_document_read_failed: The project’s drawing could not be read. Try again to load it.
designer_document_save_failed: The change to the rectangle could not be saved. Try again to save it.
designer_document_changed: The drawing changed. Try again to load the current drawing.
designer_viewport_unsupported: The Designer viewport is available on Windows. You can still create and select projects here.
designer_viewport_project_missing: This project is unavailable. Select another project in the sidebar.
designer_viewport_unavailable: The OpenGL viewport could not open. Check your graphics driver and try again.
designer_viewport_render_failed: The viewport could not draw the rectangle. Try again to reopen it.
designer_viewport_placement_failed: The viewport could not be positioned. Resize the window and try again.
designer_viewport_closed: The viewport closed. Try again to reopen it.
designer_projects_failed: The projects could not be read.
designer_create_description: Names a project that the design surface belongs to.
designer_error_name_taken: Another project has that name. Choose another one.
designer_error_storage_failed: The Designer plugin could not save the project. Try again.
